subject: general
question: The 1997 ______ Committee Report on Small Enterprises provided the intellectual foundation as well as a practical roadmap for this important reform.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Abid Hussain**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 __ 
• The **1997 Abid Hussain Committee Report** was a landmark document that provided critical insights into the challenges faced by **small enterprises** in India and proposed reforms to address them. 
• It highlighted the need for a **comprehensive policy framework** to support small enterprises, which play a vital role in the Indian economy by generating employment and contributing to GDP. 
• The committee emphasized the importance of reducing **regulatory bottlenecks** and enhancing access to **credit** for small enterprises, which often struggle due to financial constraints. 
• It also advocated for the promotion of **entrepreneurship development** programs to foster innovation and skill development among small business owners. 
• The recommendations of the Abid Hussain Committee laid the foundation for several policy measures aimed at improving the ecosystem for small and medium enterprises (SMEs) in India. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 
• **Abid Hussain:** 
• Abid Hussain was a **distinguished economist** and a former **Indian diplomat** who made significant contributions to policy-making in India. 
• He served as the **India’s ambassador to the United States** from 1990 to 1992 and held several key positions in the Indian government, including as a member of the **Planning Commission**. 
• His expertise in economics and governance made him a pivotal figure in various committees, including the one on **Small Enterprises**. 
• **Challenges for Small Enterprises:** 
• Small enterprises often face challenges such as **limited access to credit**, high regulatory compliance costs, lack of skilled labor, and inadequate infrastructure. 
• They are also vulnerable to market fluctuations and face stiff competition from larger businesses and multinational corporations. 
• **Policy Reforms Post-1997:** 
• Following the recommendations of the Abid Hussain Committee, the government introduced measures to **simplify registration processes** for small enterprises and improve their access to institutional finance. 
• The establishment of dedicated financial institutions like the **Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI)** was a step in this direction. 
• Programs to promote **technology adoption** and skill development were also launched to enhance the competitiveness of small enterprises. 
• **Comparison of Other Options:** 
• **P. L. Tandon:** Known for the Tandon Committee Report (1974) on working capital management in India, which focused on the banking sector rather than small enterprises. 
• **K. L. Rekhi:** Not associated with major contributions related to small enterprises or policy frameworks. 
• **Abhijit Sen:** An economist known for his work in agriculture and rural development but not related to the 1997 committee on small enterprises.
